## Jot v0.2.11

Auto-built from `main` (`93f33f79b4ab901b76ebacb215a61ae4f87c76dd`).

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Version name | `0.2.11` |
| Version code | `11` |
| Commit | `93f33f79b4ab901b76ebacb215a61ae4f87c76dd` |

### Install packages

| Platform | File | How to install |
|----------|------|----------------|
| **Android** | `*-android-release.apk` | Transfer to phone → open → allow install (debug-keystore; not Play Store) |
| **Windows** | `*-windows-x64-setup.exe` | Run the setup wizard (unsigned — SmartScreen may warn) |
| **macOS Apple Silicon** | `*-macos-arm64.dmg` | Open DMG → drag **Jot** to **Applications** |
| **macOS Intel** | `*-macos-x64.dmg` | Same as above (x86_64) |

Portable zips may also be attached for Windows / macOS.

Linux / iOS packages are not produced by CI.

See [docs/branching-and-release.md](docs/branching-and-release.md).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AlexWuYh/Jot/compare/v0.2.10...v0.2.11
